description: This file configures test environment settings for the Feishu extension in a project. It imports helper functions and defines functions to load test include patterns from environment variables, and to create a scoped Vitest configuration for the Feishu extension.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if no argument is provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig( createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the Feishu extension, with default settings including test roots, environment, directory, and setup files.
